Name: Single Staircase
Author: artsbymat
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Single Staircase is a lightweight SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley 1.6 that limits players to placing only one Staircase per floor visit in The Mines and Skull Cavern. This encourages more strategic exploration while preventing players from skipping multiple floors using Staircases.[/color]

The limit is tracked independently for each local or split-screen player and resets whenever a player leaves the floor.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if you haven't already.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract the mod archive.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the [i]SingleStaircase [/i]folder into your [i]Stardew Valley Mods[/i] directory.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8](Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu to enable or disable the mod through the in-game configuration menu.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]One Staircase per floor visit: Prevents players from placing more than one Staircase during a single visit to a floor in The Mines or Skull Cavern.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Per-player tracking: Each local or split-screen player has an independent Staircase limit.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Automatic reset: The limit resets when leaving a floor, allowing another Staircase to be placed upon revisiting it.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Safe placement blocking: Failed placement attempts do not count toward the limit, and blocked Staircases are not consumed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Natural ladders and shafts unaffected: Naturally generated ladders and shafts do not count toward the limit.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Dungeon exclusions: The Quarry Mine and Volcano Dungeon are not affected.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional configuration: Supports Generic Mod Config Menu for conveniently enabling or disabling the mod.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0 or later.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, for in-game configuration).[/color][/*]
[/list]
